footer.tagline: Six small browser games. No accounts, no ads - just play.

hangBotDescription: Hangman - guess the letters right before it's too late!
scribbleBotDescription: Scribbl.io - Where the bot draws and you guess the word!
atlasMasterDescription: AtlasMaster - Test your knowledge of Europe, Asia, Africa, South America, the USA and Norway!

actions.banHelp: The player is signed out of SpillArena and can't sign in again. The name stays taken, so it can't be registered again.
actions.resetPinHelp: Give the player the new PIN yourself. Sessions they already have keep working.

actions.deleteHelp: Deletes the account and all saved progress. This can't be undone.
actions.selfHint: This is your own account. Change it from the account menu.
actions.adminHint: Admins can't be banned, renamed, deleted or given a new PIN. Admin rights are removed in the database, not here.
